fieldguide.entity.meanderingmobs.aukvult:
Thalassic Aukvultures are such gregarious and bonded creatures that to tame one you must find them isolated.

Despite their sheer size dominance, they are quite peaceful animals. However they are not afraid to defend themselves with a bone crushing bite that can easily crush through large femurs.

Gigagret Aukvultures could be argued for being more common for being able to be found in multitudes of different wetlands. 

However this couldn't be further from the truth as they only spawn alone or in pairs at very low numbers. It is perhaps suspected the low population density is from prey choice.
